text:
Yes — **Monzo is a licensed UK bank**, and the app is how you manage your account. The Bank of England lists it as **Monzo Bank Limited**, firm reference **730427**. ([bankofengland.co.uk](https://www.bankofengland.co.uk/prudential-regulation/authorisations/which-firms-does-the-pra-regulate?utm_source=openai))

If Monzo were to fail, the **Financial Services Compensation Scheme (FSCS)** would protect your eligible deposits up to **£120,000 per person** across your accounts with Monzo Bank Limited, not £120,000 per account. ([monzo.com](https://monzo.com/help/legal-stuff/deposit-protection-fscs?utm_source=openai))
